title: BM25-Augmented Many-Shot Translation for Low-Resource North-Eastern Indian Languages
abstract: arXiv:2608.13722v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper describes the University of Florida Gators submission to the WMT26 Low-Resource Indic Language Translation shared task. We adapt the retrieval-augmented many-shot translation pipeline from our AmericasNLP 2026 system to translate between English and eleven North-Eastern Indian languages in both directions. At inference time, BM25 retrieves the most similar parallel examples from a language-specific training bank, and Gemini 2.5 Flash translates the input conditioned on these examples. No model fine-tuning is involved. Training banks combine official WMT26 data with publicly available corpora such as Samanantar and prior WMT shared task releases. A grid search over retrieval count r and development exemplar count d across all 22 language-direction pairs selects the best configuration for each submission.

translated_title: 基于BM25增强的多示例翻译用于低资源印度东北部语言
translated_abstract: 本文描述了佛罗里达大学鳄鱼队对WMT26低资源印度语言翻译共享任务的提交。我们调整了AmericasNLP 2026系统中的检索增强多示例翻译流水线，用于英语与十一种印度东北部语言之间的双向翻译。在推理时，BM25从特定语言的训练库中检索最相似的平行示例，Gemini 2.5 Flash基于这些示例对输入进行翻译，无需模型微调。训练库结合了官方WMT26数据与公开语料库（如Samanantar）以及先前WMT共享任务的发布数据。通过对所有22个语言方向对进行检索数量r和开发示例数量d的网格搜索，为每个提交选择最佳配置。
tldr: 本文提出一种无需微调的检索增强多示例翻译方法，利用BM25检索相似示例并借助Gemini 2.5 Flash，在WMT26低资源印度东北部语言翻译任务中实现了英语与11种语言的双向翻译。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a fine-tuning-free retrieval-augmented many-shot translation approach that uses BM25 to retrieve similar examples and Gemini 2.5 Flash for translation, enabling bidirectional English-to-11-languages translation in the WMT26 low-resource North-Eastern Indian language task.
